description.value: Hopcott Farms Bistro is a farm-to-table lunch spot on a working beef and cranberry farm that has operated in Pitt Meadows since 1932, serving house-made burgers, sandwiches, and baked goods alongside a full espresso bar using organic fair-trade coffee. Cyclists can eat inside the cozy bistro or on the outdoor patio, with the farm's own beef featuring prominently on the menu. The broader farm property includes a butcher market, cranberry bogs, and seasonal agri-tourism events, making it a distinctive rural stop on the Pitt Meadows flat-land cycling routes.

address.value: 18385 Old Dewdney Trunk Road, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2R9
